title: What you might be wondering right now.

items.question: How fast will the landing page be ready?
items.answer: Usually in 3–7 days, once your goal, offer and feedback are clear.

items.question: Do I have to write the copy myself?
items.answer: No. I help you structure your offer clearly and put it into words people understand.

items.question: Can the landing page be extended later?
items.answer: Yes. It can later become part of a larger website or gain additional pages.

items.question: Does it make sense if I already have a website?
items.answer: Yes. It can sit alongside your website — for an offer, campaign, or target group.

items.question: Do I need to run ads right away?
items.answer: No. You can also use it for outreach, referrals, social media, or direct contacts.

items.question: Who is this not for?
items.answer: If your offer is unclear or you need many subpages, a simple landing page probably isn't the right first step.
